risk_factors.heading: Our supply agreements with our OEM customers are generally requirements contracts, and a decline in the production requirements of any of our customers, and in particular our largest customers, could adversely impact our revenues and profitability.
risk_factors.quote: In most instances our OEM customers agree to purchase their requirements for specific products but are not required to purchase any minimum amount of products from us.

risk_factors.heading: Our inability to effectively manage the timing, quality and costs of new program launches could adversely affect our financial performance.
risk_factors.quote: Given the complexity of new program launches, we may experience difficulties managing product quality, timeliness and associated costs.

risk_factors.heading: Adverse developments affecting one or more of our suppliers could harm our profitability.
risk_factors.quote: Any significant disruption in our supplier relationships, particularly relationships with sole-source suppliers, could harm our profitability.

risk_factors.heading: The discontinuation or loss of business, or lack of commercial success with respect to a particular product for which we are a significant supplier could reduce our sales and harm our profitability.
risk_factors.quote: If our OEM customers successfully in-source products currently manufactured by us, the discontinuation or loss of business for products which we are a significant supplier could reduce our sales and harm our profitability.

risk_factors.heading: Increases in costs of the materials and other supplies that we use in our products may have a negative impact on our business.
risk_factors.quote: In recent periods there have been significant fluctuations in the global prices of copper, petroleum-based resin products, semiconductors and fuel charges, which have had and may continue to have an unfavorable impact

risk_factors.heading: Our hedging activities to address commodity price fluctuations may not be successful in offsetting future increases in those costs or may reduce or eliminate the benefits of any decreases in those costs.
risk_factors.quote: Our hedging activities are not designed to mitigate long-term commodity price fluctuations and, therefore, will not protect from long-term commodity price increases.
